The two dissenting councillors did not object to the bridge itself but to the funding: 300,000 dollars will come from a reserve that had been earmarked for resealing roads in the shire's north. system: You are a staff engineer reviewing design documents. Be constructive and specific.
turns:
This is an architecture decision record a teammate wrote. Summarise the decision in two sentences, then tell me the three weakest points in the argument.

ADR-019: Replace the nightly batch sync with event streaming

Status: proposed

Context
The warehouse system and the web store share stock levels through a batch job that runs at 01:00 each night. It exports every product's quantity from the warehouse database to a file, and the store imports the file at 02:00. During the day the store decrements its own copy of the quantity on each sale. The two numbers drift apart whenever stock is adjusted in the warehouse (damaged goods, returns, deliveries arriving), and we oversell. Last quarter there were 212 oversold orders, each of which costs us a refund, an apology voucher and usually a bad review. The batch job also fails outright about once a month, typically because the export file is truncated, and then the store runs on two-day-old numbers.

Decision
We will publish every stock change in the warehouse as an event to a message broker, and the store will consume those events and update its quantities within seconds. We will run our own three-node broker cluster on the existing virtual machines. The nightly batch will be kept for the first three months as a reconciliation step and then removed.

Consequences
Overselling should drop to nearly zero because the store will always have current numbers. The team will learn event streaming, which is a valuable skill and something we expect to use for other integrations such as order status and pricing. Operating the broker is additional work but the vendor documentation says a three-node cluster is straightforward to run. The warehouse system is a packaged product and does not emit events itself, so we will add database triggers on its stock table that write to an outbox table, and a small service will read the outbox and publish. The warehouse vendor has not been consulted but triggers are a standard database feature. Ordering of events per product matters and will be handled by using the product ID as the partition key. If the store is down, events will wait in the broker, which keeps them for seven days.

Alternatives considered
Running the batch hourly instead of nightly. Rejected because it still leaves up to an hour of drift and the batch is fragile. Having the store query the warehouse database directly at checkout. Rejected because the warehouse database is slow and sits in a different network.
Suggest a cheaper experiment the team could run in two weeks to test the main assumption before committing.

Fully remote arrangements. An employee may apply to work fully remotely. Applications are decided by the department head within 15 working days and are reviewed every 12 months. Fully remote employees are expected to travel to the office up to four times a year at the company's expense.

Working from another country. Working from outside the country of employment is limited to 20 working days per calendar year and needs written approval from both the manager and the people team at least 10 working days in advance, because of tax and insurance implications. Company laptops must not be taken to countries on the restricted list published by the security team.

Equipment. The company provides a laptop, a monitor, a keyboard and a headset for home use. A one-off allowance of 350 is available towards a desk or chair, claimable once every three years with a receipt. Internet and electricity costs are not reimbursed.

Availability. Core hours are 10:00 to 15:00 local time. Outside core hours employees may arrange their day as they wish provided they complete their contracted hours and attend scheduled meetings. Calendars must show working location.

Security. Work must be done on company devices. Screens must be locked when unattended and confidential calls must not be taken in public places. Loss of a device must be reported within one hour of discovery.

Changes. The company may change or withdraw a remote arrangement with four weeks' notice where there is a business reason, which will be given in writing.

turns: I deleted a notebook by accident yesterday with like 200 notes in it. Can I get it back??

turns.content:
[1] Restoring deleted notes and notebooks (updated 2026-08-19)
Deleted notes and notebooks are moved to Trash and kept for 30 days on Free plans and 90 days on Plus and Team plans. To restore: open the sidebar, choose Trash, select the item and click Restore. Restoring a notebook restores all notes that were inside it at the time of deletion. Items removed with 'Empty Trash' cannot be recovered.

[2] Version history (updated 2026-05-02)
Plus and Team plans keep a version history for each note for 180 days. Version history does not apply to deleted notebooks.

[3] Shared notebooks: what happens when the owner deletes one
When the owner deletes a shared notebook, collaborators lose access immediately. If the owner restores it from Trash, sharing settings are restored as well.

[1] Differences between mobile and desktop apps (updated 2026-09-30)
Some features are available only in the desktop and web apps: Trash management, bulk export, and template editing. On mobile, deleted items are still moved to Trash and can be restored by signing in at app.nimbusnotes.example on a computer or in a mobile browser using 'Request desktop site'.

[2] Signing in on the web
Go to app.nimbusnotes.example and sign in with the same email address you use in the mobile app.
